outputs.discrepancies: Caption states PacL1Δ5 does not bind cadmium, but panel B shows small additional peaks (low-intensity species) consistent with minor Cd-bound adducts (+1/+2), so the image does not fully support an absolute 'no binding' statement.

Caption describes panel H as showing cluster sizes, but the image labeled H displays 'Mol.% into clusters' (proportion of molecules in clusters). Panels H and I appear swapped relative to the caption.

Caption describes panel I as the proportion of molecules localized within a cluster per cell, but the image labeled I displays cluster size (nm^3). Panels H and I appear swapped relative to the caption.

Caption text contains a labeling error: the rictor MARCM clone is described as panel 'J' in the caption but the rictor image is actually panel 'I'. The image content itself matches the rictor clone description, but the panel label in the caption is incorrect.

Caption indicates panels I and K show infections with both Cr and ΔnleE over time for unprimed, LPS- and TNF-primed CMT-93 cells. Panel I shows caspase-3/7 activity traces for Unprimed Cr, LPS Cr and TNF Cr only — ΔnleE traces are not present.

Caption describes rotarod results for three genotypes (WT, Atxn1‑KI, double‑transgenic) from day 1–3 at 5, 9 and 21 weeks, but the panel displays four groups (includes an HMGB1-only genotype in addition to the three mentioned). The number of genotypes shown in the image does not match the caption description.

Caption states that co‑expression of HMGB1‑GFP reduces MitoTracker Deep Red accumulation in Atxn1(86Q)‑transfected cells, but the images show the opposite: the Atxn1(86Q) column has reduced MitoTracker signal while the Atxn1(86Q)+HMGB1‑GFP column shows stronger/ restored MitoTracker staining. The visual data therefore contradict the caption wording.

The caption describes statistical analysis for both NT and NANOG iKO samples treated with DOX or DOX+Z-VAD, but the bottom bar graph displays only iKO groups (legend and bars correspond to iKO -DOX, iKO +DOX 3d, iKO +DOX 3d + Z-VAD) — NT data are not shown in the plotted quantification.
